# Recipes

Complete compositions for Augma 0.2.0. Each runs on the Showcase page (https://augma.yyj.moe/en/showcase/) and is covered by the browser tests. Copy one, then adapt the labels and state.

## Control panel

A Panel that groups a labelled Select, Switch and Slider with v-model state, a live summary and a reset action.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmPanel, AgmSelect, AgmSlider, AgmSwitch } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const mode = shallowRef('focus')
const enabled = shallowRef(true)
const opacity = shallowRef(80)
const options = [
  { label: 'Focus', value: 'focus' },
  { label: 'Explore', value: 'explore' },
]
function reset() {
  mode.value = 'focus'
  enabled.value = true
  opacity.value = 80
}
</script>

<template>
  <AgmPanel title="Control panel" class="control-example">
    <AgmSelect v-model="mode" label="Scene mode" :options="options" />
    <AgmSwitch v-model="enabled" label="Show navigation" />
    <AgmSlider v-model="opacity" label="Navigation opacity" :min="30" />
    <output>
      Current: {{ mode === 'focus' ? 'Focus' : 'Explore' }} · Navigation {{
        enabled ? 'on' : 'off'
      }}
      · {{ opacity }}%
    </output>
    <AgmButton variant="outline" @click="reset">Restore default settings</AgmButton>
  </AgmPanel>
</template>

<style scoped>
.control-example {
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
}
output {
  color: var(--agm-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}
</style>
```

## HUD states

Status text in three tones beside a ring and an indeterminate bar. Status is always written out, never colour alone.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmHudProgress, AgmHudStatus, AgmPanel } from 'augma'
</script>

<template>
  <AgmPanel title="Mission status" class="hud-example">
    <div>
      <AgmHudStatus>Interface ready</AgmHudStatus>
      <AgmHudStatus tone="warning">Awaiting permission</AgmHudStatus>
      <AgmHudStatus tone="danger">Device offline</AgmHudStatus>
    </div>
    <AgmHudProgress label="Loading assets" :value="72" variant="ring" />
    <AgmHudProgress label="Waiting for a device" indeterminate-text="In progress" />
    <p>Sample states only. Nothing here accesses a device or asks for permission.</p>
  </AgmPanel>
</template>

<style scoped>
.hud-example {
  display: grid;
  justify-items: center;
  gap: 24px;
  width: 100%;
}
.hud-example > div:first-of-type {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 20px;
}
.hud-example > .agm-progress:not(.agm-progress--ring) {
  width: 100%;
}
p {
  color: var(--agm-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}
</style>
```

## Theming

Retheme one subtree by overriding semantic --agm-* variables; structure and keyboard behaviour stay the same.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AgmButton, AgmHudProgress, AgmPanel } from 'augma'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const value = shallowRef(25)
</script>

<template>
  <AgmPanel title="Custom accent color" class="theme-example">
    <AgmHudProgress label="Sample progress" :value="value" />
    <AgmButton @click="value = value >= 100 ? 0 : value + 25">
      Advance progress
    </AgmButton>
    <p>Customize colors through semantic variables; component structure and keyboard behavior stay the same.</p>
  </AgmPanel>
</template>

<style scoped>
.theme-example {
  --agm-accent: #7951bd;
  --agm-accent-hover: #65419e;
  --agm-on-accent: #fff;
  display: grid;
  gap: 20px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
}
p {
  color: var(--agm-muted);
  font-size: 13px;
}
</style>
```
